snippet.title: Precursors: Armored Angels - Final Release Trailer
snippet.description:
This trailer captures the final state of the Armored Angels game design.

It contains many community suggestions, i.e. the possibility of free camera rotation and other tweaks. And some new modes for starting the game.

We would like to thank everyone involved in the work on the game, as well as for any suggestions on how to make it better.

We finally got a solid product that has its supporters. Thank you.

Game Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796100/Precursors_Armored_Angels/
